definitions.gloss: flushing; hot flush; burning sensation in the body
definitions.explanation: A sensation of warmth or heat in the body, especially the face, caused by bathing, exercise, embarrassment, fever, alcohol, or hormonal changes.

examples.english: The flushing in my face won't go away.

examples.japanese: お⟦{風呂|ふろ}{上|あ}がり→風呂上がり：22451_furoagari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{火照|ほて}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{冷|さ}ます→冷ます：02113_samasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: I opened the window to cool down the flush from getting out of the bath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{火照|ほて}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じ→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、なん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦やり{遂|と}げた→やり遂げる：16745_yaritogeru⟧。
examples.english: While feeling a burning flush throughout my body from nervousness, I managed to get through the speech to the end.

notes:
The noun form of the verb ⟦{火照|ほて}る→火照る：13391_hoteru⟧ (to feel hot, to flush). Describes a warm or burning sensation in the body, especially the face, from heat, embarrassment, fever, or physical exertion.

USAGE:
- Most commonly refers to the face flushing red and feeling hot
- Can be caused by bathing, exercise, embarrassment, alcohol, fever, or hormonal changes
- Often written in hiragana as ほてり, especially in medical contexts
- Common in health and beauty contexts (e.g., menopausal hot flashes)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{火照|ほて}り: facial flushing
- {火照|ほて}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel a flush
- {火照|ほて}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: the flush subsides
- {火照|ほて}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{冷|さ}ます→冷ます：02113_samasu⟧: to cool down the flush
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{火照|ほて}り: body flush

SIMILAR WORDS:
- のぼせ: rush of blood to the head, dizziness from heat — related but implies feeling dizzy or lightheaded
- {紅潮|こうちょう}: blushing, flushing red — focuses on the visible redness rather than the sensation
- {熱|ほ}てり: same word, sometimes written with this kanji — interchangeable
